relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: The NLRP3 responds to the stimulation of metabolic stress signals, leading to caspase-1 activation and IL-1 β production, which play an important role in a variety of diseases.

relationships.subject: NLRP3
relationships.evidence_quote: research has confirmed that NLRP-3 can be activated in the case of bacterial infection, promoting the synthesis and secretion of downstream IL-1β, IL-18, and other proinflammatory mediators

relationships.subject: Tuberculous peritonitis
relationships.evidence_quote: NLRP3 in RG before treatment was (94.05 ± 11.82) pg/mL, higher than CG (P < 0.05, Figure 1(b)).

key_findings: Ascites ADA and NLRP3 were higher in tuberculous peritonitis than in cancerous ascites controls and combined detection predicted TP (sensitivity 89.83%, specificity 73.08%).
Post-treatment ADA and NLRP3 fell, correlated negatively with clinical efficacy, and were higher in relapsing patients.
